risks.detail: Evidence flow documented, schema frozen. Risk: Agent generates PASS claim without saving evidence files.
risks.mitigation: Schema validator checks required files; final-zip-self-consistency checks ZIP integrity.
risks.name: Evidence Omission

risks.detail: CFP-001 gate exists. Risk: Agent writes PASS in report but evidence says FAIL.
risks.mitigation: validate-evidence-gates.ps1 detects CFP-001; schema validator checks report consistency.
risks.name: Report/Evidence Contradiction

risks.detail: Mailbox schema exists but mailbox is advisory (not hard gate). Agents may use spawn_agent/resume_agent without preserving handoff artifacts.
risks.mitigation: Require mailbox evidence for phases that claim multi-agent handoff.
risks.name: Missing Mailbox Evidence

risks.detail: Codex may compress/truncate long conversations. Agents may lose task context, settings, or handoff details.
risks.mitigation: Contract-first planning (read SPEC.md, write PLAN.md). Handoff files in independent workspace files.
risks.name: Context Compression Data Loss

risks.detail: Agent may write final ZIP outside harness/outputs/.
risks.mitigation: Schema validator and final-zip-self-consistency check absolute path. Report must state ZIP path.
risks.name: Bundle Path Drift

risks.detail: Phases 6C-A through S2 were short runs (< 30 min). Overnight or multi-hour runs untested. Agent timeouts, token expiry, context exhaustion likely.
risks.mitigation: Phase 6C-S2 proves continuation. Heartbeat and timeout sweep exist. But overnight not proven.
risks.name: Long-Run Stability

risks.detail: Codex requires user approval for escalated operations. Long runs may stall on approval prompts.
risks.mitigation: Prefix rules for approved command prefixes. But new commands may still require approval.
risks.name: Approval Interruptions

risks.detail: codex exec worker pool not implemented. All current multi-agent is via spawn_agent within same session.
risks.mitigation: Phase 6C-F explored token auth for external workers but not production ready.
risks.name: External Worker Pool

risks.detail: Current test fixture is bookmark-manager (~30 files). Large projects with 100+ files may have complex merge conflicts.
risks.mitigation: Git worktree spike shows feasibility. But large-scale merge not tested.
risks.name: Large Project Integration Complexity

risks.detail: Codex CLI, spawn_agent, resume_agent behavior may change across versions. Harness assumptions may break.
risks.mitigation: Schema-frozen requirements. Phase validators are versioned. Re-validate after Codex updates.
risks.name: Codex Capability Drift

honestAnswer: Yes, future projects may still have problems. The expected failure modes are now explicit and machine-checkable. The biggest remaining risks are long-run stability, external worker pool, approval interruptions, and large-project context drift.
